description: Defines the enumeration GLAccountType representing different types of general ledger accounts, including methods for conversion and type checks.

classes.name: GLAccountType
classes.description: Enumeration for different GL account types with utility methods.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the account type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string for the account type.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string to the corresponding GLAccountType wrapped in EnumOptionData.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding GLAccountType.

methods.name: getMinValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum value among account types.

methods.name: getMaxValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum value among account types.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the enum constant as a string.

methods.name: isAssetType
methods.description: Checks if the account type is ASSET.

methods.name: isLiabilityType
methods.description: Checks if the account type is LIABILITY.

methods.name: isEquityType
methods.description: Checks if the account type is EQUITY.

methods.name: isIncomeType
methods.description: Checks if the account type is INCOME.

methods.name: isExpenseType
methods.description: Checks if the account type is EXPENSE.
